description: A forklift has damaged a container of Sodium Cyanide near Sulfuric Acid storage tanks. Use CAMEO Chemicals reactivity prediction tool at https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/ to predict what would happen if these two chemicals are mixed. Add both Sulfuric Acid (UN 1830) and Sodium Cyanide (UN 1689) to the reactivity prediction, then document ALL predicted hazards — especially whether Hydrogen Cyanide (HCN) gas would be generated. Save your findings to ~/Documents/reactivity_report.txt including: the chemicals analyzed, all predicted reaction products, hazard types and severity, and emergency response recommendations. The scenario details are in ~/Desktop/reactivity_scenario.txt.
